summary: Tug Mountain tower, Washington County, Maine: a 1918 Maine Forest Service map is centered on it; a May 2026 trip report found only cables and an anchor pin at the former site.

facts.status_note: Former fire tower site. A May 2026 trip report found only some cables and an anchor pin.
facts.agency: Maine Forest Service (named as mapmaker of the 1918 panorama)

visit.trail_note: A May 2026 trip report describes parking along Route 9 on the north side, where there is shoulder room, following a logging road, then a 0.2mi rough bushwhack to the summit

events.note: Maine Forest Service panorama dated 1918 is centered on the Tug Mt. fire tower in Township 30 MD, ME

notes_for_editor: Thin record: one 1918 map and one trip report, plus the FFLA listing for the coordinates and gone status. Two Facebook posts from the FFLA Maine chapter came up in search with a claim that the lookout was erected in 1913 and abandoned in 1928. They could not be read by fetch_text or WebFetch, so the claim is not cited; verify before adding a build or abandonment date. No source read states who owns the land or whether it is open to the public. The 1918 map shows a tower by that year, but does not give a build date.
